objective: Investigate feasibility of 80% prediction accuracy without data leakage

knife_edge_boundary_noise.definition: Returns falling within +/-0.5% of the arbitrary +/-2.0% target boundaries
knife_edge_boundary_noise.irreducible_bayes_error_implication: 20.3% of observations lie within 50 bps of the class threshold. Distinguishing a +1.98% return (HOLD) from +2.02% return (BUY) is governed by intraday market microstructure noise, setting a theoretical Bayes error rate that caps 3-class accuracy well below 80% without look-ahead label leakage.

full_coverage_100pct.limiting_factor: Maximizes accuracy by exploiting the ~50% HOLD baseline; severely suppresses minority BUY/SELL signals.

balanced_full_coverage.limiting_factor: Maintains balanced active trading signals; accuracy ceiling is 43.9%.

selective_prediction_peak.limiting_factor: Filtering to top 2.7% high-confidence events peaks at 51.7% accuracy. An 80% target is not supported.
